Linetype scale

Source: R/scale.R
scale_linetype.Rd

Maps data values to line types. Supports discrete and reverse scales; continuous variables are not supported.

Usage

scale_linetype(
  plot,
  name = ggplot2::waiver(),
  trans = "discrete",
  limits = NULL,
  range = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

plot

A plotit object.

name

Scale title (legend name).

trans

Scale transformation. Default "discrete". Allowed: "discrete", "reverse". "identity" and "binned" are rejected with targeted error messages.

limits

Data domain.

range

Linetype names or codes (c("solid","dashed")). NULL = ggplot2 defaults.

breaks

Legend key positions.

labels

Legend key labels.

...

Passed to the underlying ggplot2 scale function.

Value

A modified plotit object.

Examples

plotit(ggplot2::economics, encode(x = date, y = unemploy)) |>
  mark_line() |>
  scale_linetype()
